connection_status_shape.name: connection_status_shape
connection_status_shape.value:
("connections"."status" = 'pending' and "connections"."ticket_hash" is not null and "connections"."grant_id" is null)
        or ("connections"."status" = 'active' and "connections"."ticket_hash" is null and "connections"."grant_id" is not null and "connections"."activated_at" is not null)
        or ("connections"."status" = 'revoked' and "connections"."ticket_hash" is null and "connections"."revoked_at" is not null)

grant_budget_spend.name: grant_budget_spend
grant_budget_spend.value: "grants"."kind" <> 'x402-budget' or ("grants"."token" is not null and "grants"."allowance" is not null and "grants"."period" = 'day')

owner_call_shape.name: owner_call_shape
owner_call_shape.value:
jsonb_array_length("owner_calls"."calls") between 1 and 10
        and ("owner_calls"."state" <> 'sent' or "owner_calls"."calls_id" is not null)
        and ("owner_calls"."state" not in ('landed', 'reverted') or ("owner_calls"."calls_id" is not null and "owner_calls"."tx_hash" is not null))

payment_shape.name: payment_shape
payment_shape.value:
("payments"."state" = 'pending' and "payments"."nonce" is null and "payments"."authorization" is null and "payments"."fenced" is null)
        or ("payments"."state" in ('signed', 'unknown') and "payments"."nonce" is not null and "payments"."authorization" is not null
            and "payments"."authorized" is not null and "payments"."deadline" is not null and "payments"."signed_at" is not null)
        or ("payments"."state" = 'settled' and "payments"."kind" = 'free' and "payments"."nonce" is null)
        or ("payments"."state" = 'settled' and "payments"."kind" = 'paid' and "payments"."nonce" is not null and "payments"."amount" is not null)
        or ("payments"."state" = 'failed' and "payments"."finished_at" is not null)

permission_request_shape.name: permission_request_shape
permission_request_shape.value:
("permission_requests"."method" = 'revoke' and "permission_requests"."permission_id" is not null)
        or ("permission_requests"."method" = 'grant' and ("permission_requests"."state" <> 'approved' or "permission_requests"."permission_id" is not null))
        or ("permission_requests"."method" = 'sign' and "permission_requests"."idempotency_key" is not null and "permission_requests"."request_hash" is not null
          and "permission_requests"."sign_kind" is not null and ("permission_requests"."state" <> 'approved' or "permission_requests"."signature" is not null))
        or "permission_requests"."method" = 'add_funds'

send_shape.name: send_shape
send_shape.value:
"sends"."amount" >= 0 and ("sends"."idempotency_key" is null) = ("sends"."request_hash" is null) and (
        ("sends"."state" = 'open' and "sends"."finished_at" is null)
        or ("sends"."state" = 'landed' and "sends"."tx_hash" is not null and "sends"."finished_at" is not null)
        or ("sends"."state" = 'released' and "sends"."finished_at" is not null))

swap_shape.name: swap_shape
swap_shape.value:
"swaps"."state" in ('quoting', 'quote_failed', 'quote_rejected', 'abandoned')
        or ("swaps"."quote_id" is not null and "swaps"."call" is not null and "swaps"."wallet_url" is not null and "swaps"."approve_by" is not null)
